items.label: MA-AG civil: Kilgore Insurance Agency
items.detail: Suffolk Superior Court final judgment after a 22-day trial over hidden agency fees added to insurance premiums; date is the announcement date. Release says more than $3.5 million, entered as a floor: about $2.2 million restitution plus over $1.3 million prejudgment interest. The agency, a former agent and two owners are ordered to pay together; the individuals are left out. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-ma-ag-2015-kilgore; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.reason: Shared total, split not stated: Final judgment against Kilgore Insurance Agency, its former agent and the two owners (three individuals): one obligation, no per-defendant split, no 'jointly and severally' wording in the release or the Appeals Court opinion (Commonwealth v. Crowther, 17-P-29, 23 Jul 2018). A judgment, appealed, not confirmed cash. The AG's 31 Jan 2019 release reports a later judgment of nearly $5.2 million against the same four defendants; it does not reconcile with this one and has not been read as a row. Source (read 2026-10-11): "the defendants have been ordered to pay a total of more than $3.5 million". The primary document gives one total for payers that include anyone outside the company, so the total is counted for no company; the row stays in gross (overlap group shared-ma-ag-2015-kilgore; data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
excluded_amounts.category_label: Split not stated by the source (cash from relief, or between payers)
